title.zh: 把声音做出来，也把活干完
title.en: Make the sound, then finish the job

lead.zh: 从声学、录音、混音到 MIDI 与交付：按“你现在卡在哪”来读，而不是按设备清单。每条都带可听的例子和能上手的步骤。
lead.en: From acoustics and recording to mixing, MIDI and delivery — organised by where you are stuck, not by gear lists. Every entry pairs listening examples with steps you can use.

needs_sub.zh: 先定位问题，再进对应的条目；顺序错了，工具越多越乱。
needs_sub.en: Locate the problem first. Get the order wrong and more tools only make it worse.

d.zh: 先搭一条能重复的工作流：文件怎么放、轨道怎么命名、参考曲放哪。
d.en: Build a repeatable workflow first: where files live, how tracks are named, where references sit.

t.en: The mix is muddy, harsh or dull

d.zh: 先能听出四种症状，再决定动哪个插件；判断不准时，别加处理。
d.en: Hear the four symptoms before touching a plug-in. If the judgement is unsure, stop processing.

d.zh: 房间与摆位决定了一半结果，话筒和话放只决定另一半。
d.en: Room and placement decide half the result; mic and preamp the other half.

d.zh: 力度、时钟与映射弄对了，软音源才像乐器；否则只是会响的采样。
d.en: Velocity, clock and mapping make a virtual instrument feel played; otherwise it is just samples that sound.

d.zh: 先对齐剪辑与情绪曲线，再写主题；交付要按画面版本管理。
d.en: Align with the cut and the emotional curve before writing themes; manage delivery by picture version.

d.zh: 先拆交付物和时间点，再决定编曲密度与制作顺序。
d.en: Break the deliverable and deadlines down first, then decide arrangement density and order of work.

d.zh: 从总谱到分谱、从鼓组到人声、从母带到 DDP，这三段最容易在交接时出错。
d.en: Score to parts, drums to voice, master to DDP: three places where hand-offs break.

ladder_title.zh: 一条从听到交付的路线

ladder_sub.zh: 顺序有讲究：听不准，后面每一步都会加倍返工。
ladder_sub.en: Order matters: if you cannot hear it, every later step doubles the rework.

d.zh: 知道房间和耳机的偏差，再谈好坏。
d.en: Know your room and headphone bias before judging quality.

d.zh: 增益结构、相位与摆位先过关。
d.en: Gain structure, phase and placement first.

d.zh: 按症状处理，不按插件顺序处理。
d.en: Work by symptom, not by plug-in order.

d.zh: 响度、真峰值、分轨命名，一样都不能少。
d.en: Loudness, true peak and stem naming, all of them.

picks_sub.zh: 从选 DAW 到混音判断，覆盖最常被问的几步。
picks_sub.en: From choosing a DAW to judging a mix, covering the questions that come up most.

why.zh: 先选工作方式，再选软件；别反过来。
why.en: Choose the workflow before the software, not the other way round.

why.zh: 四种症状对应四类动作，听完能自查。
why.en: Four symptoms, four kinds of move; you can self-check after one listen.

why.zh: 一条链上每个环节都能毁掉录音。
why.en: Every link in the chain can ruin a take.

why.zh: 先分清楚你改的是演奏还是声音。
why.en: Know whether you are editing a performance or a sound.

why.zh: 配乐的时间码、版本与交付从第一天就要管。
why.en: Timecode, versions and delivery need managing from day one.

why.zh: 一件真实的活，怎么从需求走到成品。
why.en: A real job, from brief to finished track.

why.zh: 制谱不是打字，缩编与分谱才是工作量。
why.en: Engraving is not typing; condensing and parts are the work.

why.zh: 鼓组拾音先解决相位，再换话筒。
母带链的顺序错了，后面每个插件都在补前一个的错。
why.en: Wrong chain order makes every later plug-in fix the previous mistake.

trails_sub.zh: 从灵感到成品、从录音到混音、从画面到配乐。
trails_sub.en: Idea to finished track, recording to mix, picture to score.

d.zh: 结构、编曲、混音、交付，一站不停。
d.en: Structure, arrangement, mix, delivery, without skipping.

d.zh: 先解决房间与相位，再谈话筒品牌。
d.en: Solve the room and phase before discussing microphone brands.

d.zh: 音画关系、主题动机与分轨交付。
d.en: Picture sync, thematic motifs and stem delivery.
